findings.issue: Module-level SWR cache has no eviction and is keyed partly by user-controlled strings (every /pokemon/:name, /moves/:name request inserts an entry, including 404s), so memory grows without bound under a crawler or hostile traffic.
findings.suggestion: Cap the Map (LRU) or at least don't cache null results for unknown user-supplied names; add a small negative-TTL instead.

findings.issue: Fragment-only endpoints (/pokemon/:name/moves, /moves-table) are reachable by direct navigation and return bare HTML with no Cache-Control, so a shared reverse proxy can cache a fragment and serve it to a full-page request; the Vary guard exists only on '/'.
findings.suggestion: Send Cache-Control: private (or no-store) on all dynamic responses, and consider a full-page fallback or redirect for non-HX-Request requests to the fragment routes.

findings.issue: POST /team/remove (and /team/add) overwrite the team cookie even when sameSite=Lax meant the request carried no cookie, so a cross-site form can silently blank or alter a visitor's team.
findings.suggestion: Only save when the incoming request carried the cookie, or register hono's csrf middleware on the /team/* POST routes.

findings.issue: fetch() to the API has no timeout or AbortSignal; a hung upstream stalls every request touching that path with no recovery.
findings.suggestion: Wrap fetch in AbortSignal.timeout() (Node 24 supports it) and let the error surface to onError.

findings.issue: serveStatic root './dist' is resolved against process.cwd(), so the production server breaks if started from any directory other than app/.
findings.suggestion: Derive an absolute path from import.meta.url (or process.cwd() fallback) so `node dist/index.js` works from anywhere.

findings.issue: The API boundary is `any` throughout (versionGroups(pokemon: any), (a: any) sorts, api<T = any>), so the app's assumptions about API records are untyped and upstream data changes fail silently.
findings.suggestion: Add minimal interfaces for the records actually consumed (species, pokemon, move, type) and type api<T> at each call site.

findings.issue: Team cookie is set without `secure: true`; production sits behind a TLS-terminating proxy per the spec.
findings.suggestion: Add `secure: true` to the setCookie options.

findings.issue: HX-Push-Url fires on every debounced keystroke of the search box, pushing a history entry per intermediate query, making the back button walk through every partial search.
findings.suggestion: Return HX-Replace-Url while typing and only push on commit (select changes, pagination), or throttle pushes.

summary: A clean, current-stable Hono/htmx implementation that follows the official jsxRenderer, form-POST, and htmx-partial patterns closely, with excellent loader/view organization and real 404/error handling. The main pre-merge asks are bounding the user-keyed SWR cache and adding Cache-Control to fragment responses, both small local fixes. Type the API boundary and this is code a team would be glad to inherit.
